product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Mount for Back-to-Back Menu Board Portrait and Landscape Displays & Order Kiosks, Fits 32" to 75" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Mount for Back-to-Back Menu Board Displays & Order Kiosks is a powerful, space-efficient solution designed to maximize visibility and functionality in modern commercial environments. Engineered to support dual screens in a back-to-back configuration, this mounting system is ideal for digital menu boards, self-service kiosks, and promotional displays that engage audiences from multiple directions. Whether placed in retail spaces, quick-service restaurants, or high-traffic public areas, it delivers a clean, professional presentation while optimizing floor space. Each screen supports up to 66 lb, and the robust floor-to-ceiling pole extends up to 9.84 ft—providing a strong vertical presence with minimal footprint.Back-to-back dual display design supports two screens on opposite sides of a single poleFits 32" to 75" landscape displays and 43" to 75" portrait displays with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×400Supports up to 66 lb per screen for most commercial-grade displaysFull-height 9.84 ft pole with reinforced 4" diameter for superior stabilityNo wall mounting required; flexible placement in open spaces and glass storefrontsOptimized for menu boards, order kiosks, and dual-purpose promotional signageSupports organized cable routing for a clean, clutter-free installationDesigned for indoor commercial use; professional installation recommended BACK-TO-BACK DUAL DISPLAY CONFIGURATIONSupports two screens mounted on opposite sides of a single pole, enabling content to be viewed from multiple directions—ideal for high-traffic environments and dual-purpose applications. OPTIMIZED FOR MENU BOARDS & ORDER KIOSKSPerfect for displaying menus, promotions, or interactive ordering interfaces, allowing businesses to serve customers efficiently while maximizing screen utilization on both sides. WIDE SCREEN COMPATIBILITYSupports a broad range of screen sizes (32" to 75" Landscape, 43" to 75" Portrait) with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×400, ensuring compatibility with most commercial TVs and monitors. REINFORCED 4" DIAMETER POLEEngineered for superior strength and rigidity, the large-diameter pole minimizes movement and flex—especially beneficial for touchscreen kiosk applications where screen stability is critical. FLEXIBLE FLOOR-TO-CEILING INSTALLATIONEliminates the need for wall mounting, allowing placement in areas with limited wall access such as glass storefronts or open floor plans.
